actions.title: Read one day's to-do list, or the undated backlog
actions.does: The user's to-do list for one day, or the undated backlog (date=backlog), sorted by urgency (urgent, high, normal, low) then the user's own order: each task's urgency, project, status, tags, Markdown description and subtasks (each with its status). Read only.
actions.output: {date, backlog: count of undated tasks, tasks: [{id, title, urgency, project, status, tags: [string], order, description, subtasks: [{id, title, status}]}], projects: [{name, color}], tags: [string]}

date.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, or backlog for undated tasks; today when left out

actions.title: List the projects in the to-do list
actions.does: Every project in the Günlük list, with how many tasks it has and how many are not done. Read only.

actions.title: Read unfinished tasks left from earlier days
actions.does: Every task dated before today that is not done (waiting included, backlog excluded), urgency first, then oldest day. Read only; nothing is moved.
actions.output: {today, tasks: [{id, day, title, urgency, project, status, tags, subtasks}]}

today.desc: YYYY-MM-DD; this Mac's today when left out
